reviews.comment: He is very scattered during lecture. You can't read his handwriting. Not my first recommendation but I would not 'not' recommend him

So Im taking Buckley currently ( spring 2022) and he is pretty good. He is not too hard of a prof and definitely gives good feedback but there are downsides. He is a pretty tough grader and his lectures are not great but overall not a bad choice. See if you can get into a prof will distribution of 3.5+ if not Professor Buckley is still a solid pick
